_comment: TP rules the ROM ships, picked from the balance model (FINDINGS section 10). Edit here, then run `python3 tools/balance/costcurve.py --write` to bake them into include/constants/tp_model.h and the .tpCost of every move in src/data/moves_info.h. `make check` fails if the ROM is out of sync. engine.Rules uses these as its defaults.
